tagline: A spoken phrase becomes one of fifteen commands, or nothing. It only decides; ARMOR-SERVER acts.
description: ARMOR-SERVER and the wall panel call the voice service on the loopback address. It normalises the transcript, matches it against fifteen commands in eight languages, issues signed single-use confirmations and applies the silence policy. Speech engines are programs the installation chooses.
